title: Three Terms and One Short Table
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：group　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 group 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the organiser ① formed a group that no neighbour in the hall would have described, and she said the forming was the whole of the term. The ② group, meaning the people themselves and not the committee, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; a group, she said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ group in that hall had the same short table beside it, and the ④ group at the far corner, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A group, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the organiser said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the group was the whole of the matter, meaning the circle and not the people. The ⑥ group, meaning the circle and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; group, he said, is either something you form or the only word that means both a people and a circle. He said the circle is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ group had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short table. The ⑧ group of the whole thing, the organiser wrote in November, was one hall and three terms of describing; group, she said, is either the one at the far corner or the reason you learned to describe. She said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ group I remember is the one described in the list, which closed in 1983 and is still described as the quietest in the hall. A ⑩ group, my mother said in 1985, is the only one that improves by being described; every group, she said, is a circle that has agreed to look like a people. She said the circle was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 小组；群体（指大厅里每一组旁边的那一组）
B. n. 小组；群体（指那些人本身，与委员会相对）
C. 固定搭配：form a group 组建一个小组
D. n. 小组（指留给孩子们加入的那一个）
E. n. 群体（抽象总称，指一处大厅的小组之事）
F. n. 小组（指名单里写到、被登记过的那一个）
G. n. 圈子；乐团（指一件事里人人都进却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 圈子（抽象总称，指人人都进却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: formed a group that no neighbour in the hall would have described
The group, meaning the people themselves and not the committee
the group at the far corner
the group was the whole of the matter
the group had become a line in a list
The group of the whole thing
A group, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: form a group 意为“组建一个小组”，1976 年那位组织者组建了大厅里没有一位邻居肯描述的一个小组。
group 意为“小组、群体”，指那些人本身而不是委员会，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
group 意为“小组、群体”，指大厅里每一组旁边的那一组，每一组旁边都有同一张矮矮的桌子。
group 意为“小组”，指最远那个角落留给孩子们加入的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
group 意为“圈子、乐团”，指一件事里人人都进却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个圈子就是那件事的全部。
group 意为“圈子”，指人人都进却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个小组，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
group 意为“小组”，指名单里写到、被登记过的那一个，到 1981 年这一个成了名单里的一行。
group 意为“群体”，组织者十一月写道，整件事的小组之事是一处大厅和三个学期的描述。
group 意为“小组”，我记得的是名单里描述过的那一个，1983 年解散了，至今仍被说成大厅里最安静的一个。
group 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，小组是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的群体。
